description: This Java class defines the response to a 'ModifyAcl' command within the Eclipse Ditto framework. It manages creating, parsing, and serializing responses related to access control list modifications of 'things', including handling different HTTP status codes and JSON representations.

classes.name: ModifyAclResponse
classes.description: Represents the response to a ModifyAcl command, including creation from JSON, serialization, and managing response status and data.

methods.name: created
methods.description: Creates a response indicating a new ACL was created, with HTTP status 201.

methods.name: modified
methods.description: Creates a response indicating an ACL was modified, with HTTP status 204.

methods.name: fromJson
methods.description: Parses a JSON string or object to instantiate a ModifyAclResponse.

methods.name: getThingEntityId
methods.description: Returns the ID of the thing associated with this response.

methods.name: getAcl
methods.description: Returns the modified AccessControlList contained in this response.

methods.name: getEntity
methods.description: Serializes the ACL to JSON according to schema version, if applicable.

methods.name: getResourcePath
methods.description: Returns the JSON pointer path to the ACL resource.

methods.name: appendPayload
methods.description: Appends context data to a JSON builder for serialization.

methods.name: setDittoHeaders
methods.description: Returns a new response instance with updated headers.

methods.name: getSupportedSchemaVersions
methods.description: Returns the supported JSON schema versions (V_1).
